title: Broximal Alignment for Global Non-Convex Optimization
summary: Most non-convex optimization theory is built around gradient dynamics, leaving global convergence largely unexplored. The dominant paradigm focuses on stationarity, certifying only that the gradient norm vanishes, which is often a weak proxy for actual optimization success. In practice, gradient norms can stagnate or even increase during training, and stationary points may be far from global solutions.
